title: Jailbreaking Multimodal Large Language Models via Shuffle Inconsistency
reasoning: The paper describes a jailbreak attack (SI-Attack) designed to bypass safety filters in multimodal large language models. While it mentions avoiding 'harmful content such as violence, discrimination, fake information, or immorality' as the goal of model safety alignment, the paper itself is a technical security study of jailbreaking techniques rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious or philosophical ethical systems.
